message.about: One human player with a racket controller plays single points against one AI opponent. The player is at the bottom of the screen and the opponent is at the top.
message.goal: Start beatable. Work out what this player relies on to win points and take it away, one habit at a time, until the player wins about half the points. Win by choosing better shots, never by hitting harder or faster.

opponent.about: The AI on the other side of the net.

shot_type.when: Each time it hits the ball.

options.topspin: Heavy spin that dips late and kicks up.
options.slice: Backspin that stays low and skids.
options.dropshot: Soft and short, just over the net.

aim.when: Each time it hits the ball.

options.left_deep: Deep to the left side of the player's half.

position.when: Right after it hits the ball.

options.middle_deep: Wait at the middle of the baseline.
options.left_deep: Wait on the left of the baseline.
options.right_deep: Wait on the right of the baseline.

rotation.about: Spin from the gyro. Below 0 is backspin, above 0 is topspin.

angle.about: Direction of the shot. -1 is far left on screen, 1 is far right.

views.court: The game screen, with both halves of the court.
views.player_cam: A webcam on the player, showing the upper body and racket arm.

opponent_speed.about: How fast the opponent moves and swings.
